description: This Java class, EncodedPassword, models an encoded password with optional salt and hash function information. It provides mechanisms for parsing tokenized password strings, creating objects from Hono secrets, and formatting password representations. It is used for handling password encoding and decoding within the Hono framework.

classes.name: EncodedPassword
classes.description: Encapsulates an encoded password with optional salt, hash function, and the password hash or clear text.

methods.name: EncodedPassword
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an object from a formatted password string in {Base64(salt)}password format.

methods.name: fromHonoSecret
methods.description: Creates an EncodedPassword object from a Hono secret JSON object, extracting hash, salt, and hash function.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a formatted password string, extracts salt if present, and sets the password and salt fields.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the password, formatted as {Base64(salt)}password.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Helper method to append a Base64-encoded salt value in {Base64(salt)} format.
